scope: Original 2023 English Uprising v23-10-12, standard 2-4 human players including required standard scoring two-player Rival; optional standard CHOAM with 20 standard contracts, relevant general/Uprising official January 13 2025 FAQ. Identify ten separate Rise of Ix compatibility contracts without including their play procedure. Exclude cross-game expansions, solo, optional Rival variants including Streamlined, six-player teams and later-product components. Q59 is intentionally absent and outside scope.
independence_statement: I was a newly assigned independent challenger. I read only the final v16 questions and answer key, the four authorized complete rule/FAQ text sources, original unannotated Shaddam image with its transcription/origin metadata, and the authorized unannotated supplement-page-five image. I did not read a game summary, reader answers or grades, prior reports or conclusions, repairs, Q59 history, or parent task context. I did not communicate with readers or consult another audit conclusion. Coverage judgments came from comparison of the whole actual 101-question bank with the complete authorized textual sources and inspected primary image evidence.

method.read_completion: All 101 question and key entries including fields and top-level metadata were read in separately bounded groups. All lines of the four textual sources were read in bounded chunks using Python splitlines, including extracted final line 1205 without a newline. Every authorized support text was read completely. Tool output returned no truncation warnings. The supplied images were displayed directly and independently inspected. Original PDF paths were checked for existence only; no PDF-derived conclusion beyond the authorized extractions and supplied unannotated images is claimed.
method.coverage_credit: A key-only incidental assertion was not treated as question coverage. Each coverage claim below is tied to actual requested parts. Later questions that explicitly request a formerly incidental rule receive direct credit.
method.addition_threshold: Require a distinct source rule, source-defined alternate outcome, consequential timing/priority/exception or legal origin. Reject cosmetic renaming, ordinary changed parameters, mechanical combinations and reference lookup alone. Compare candidates to the complete bank, not just neighboring items.
method.source_coordinates: All line coordinates in verified locators refer to the explicit named file and one-based splitlines. @page values are printed PDF page markers of the corresponding extraction. Image references are regions rather than fictional text lines; arithmetic and reconciled procedural inferences are identified separately.

source_key_findings.finding: All requested question parts have source-correct expected answers within the stated scope. No substantive answer-key correction or genuine additional procedure question is required.

Several early key entries use unqualified extraction line numbers that mix or do not resolve reliably against the two supplied main-rule extractions. Printed page subjects are correct, but line references should identify the exact file and be reindexed. The per-question verified locators below are the explicit corrected coordinate map; this is a locator issue, not a rule/key error.

source_key_findings.finding: Original physical Shaddam lower-left ability explicitly instructs setting aside both Sardaukar contracts and exclusive acquisition. Q102 is supported by this original Leader evidence, not by six-player instructions or digital rules. FAQ adds no initial possession and public-contract substitution. Public18/two/16 are arithmetic consequences of this setup exception.

Q62 exact resource sets verified directly from the supplied supplement p5 image: 7 Solari, 7 spice, three Intrigues, three water, each for one VP. The text extraction alone loses icon/resource correspondence and one printed three; it is insufficient as the sole numeric locator.

Generic CHOAM two/eighteen setup in Q16/Q101 and conditional Shaddam two/sixteen public setup in Q102 are compatible. Q102 explicitly supplies the original Leader exception; do not flatten it into the generic count or treat it as six-player-only.

Q88 pre-entry Plot funding follows any-point own-turn Plot permission and entry-before-played-card/space-effects. Q89 continuing Rival turns follows skipping humans who revealed plus mandatory Rival Agent turns while supplied. Both are source-grounded operational consequences, labeled as such rather than claimed verbatim source examples.

no_additions_statement: Complete in-scope procedural coverage confirmed. No genuine additions remain under the stated novelty standard.
